picks.excerpt: Zedoc, a new agentic AI metadata platform spun out of Norway's Beat Technology, streamlines publisher workflows: subject classification (Thema, BISAC, Dewey), accessibility enrichment, speech-to-text, ONIX record generation, audiobook chapterization, and structuring product data for AI-driven discovery.
picks.rationale: Concrete new agentic AI tool that reshapes day-to-day publisher metadata and ONIX workflows — highest actionability and novelty, from the most authoritative trade outlet.

picks.excerpt: A new four-week online program for publishing professionals aims to help teams understand AI technology, build practical AI workflow systems, and set organizational guidelines around usage and protection.
picks.rationale: Practical, hands-on program giving publishing teams a concrete way to build AI workflows and internal policy — directly actionable and freshly announced.

picks.excerpt: University of Melbourne and RMIT researchers have launched a survey of Australian publishers and editors on how they actually use generative AI in their work, focusing on text-based LLMs across editorial and publishing practice.
picks.rationale: Fresh academic research mapping real-world editorial AI adoption — credible source and a distinct angle from the tool and policy picks.
